newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy 97 GDP growth won't exceed 1.2 pct -- govt.
newsitem.headline: Italy 97 GDP growth won't exceed 1.2 pct -- govt.

text.p: Italy's Gross Domestic Product (GDP) will not grow by more than 1.2 percent in 1997, according to a summary presented to parliament on Friday of the country's official quarterly state accounts.

The forecast compares with a previous official target of GDP growth of 2.0 percent in 1997 after a 0.8 percent rise last year. Cabinet secretary Enrico Micheli earlier said the the economy was expected to grow 1.2 to 1.4 percent this year.
